arguments.value: Leonard Terry Strand, born in 1965 in Sioux City, Iowa, is a United States District Judge for the Northern District of Iowa, where he has served since his confirmation in 2016 and as chief judge from 2017 to 2024. He was appointed after being nominated by President Barack Obama in 2015 to fill a vacancy created by Judge Mark W. Bennett. Earlier, he served as a U.S. Magistrate Judge for the same court from 2012 to 2016. Strand earned his B.A. from the University of Iowa in 1987 and his J.D. from the University of Iowa College of Law in 1990, and spent more than two decades in private practice in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.
